Hi Alice — thanks for the clear ask and the SOW. I attached a simplified rate card (Redwood_RateCard_Q3_v2.pdf) and drafted a short explainer below to make the token/unit mapping explicit for your finance team. Happy to jump on a call — how does Monday 09:30 PDT sound?

Short explainer (worked examples)
- Summary: hosted API billing is usage-based. We price by model + unit; units differ slightly between endpoints to reflect efficiency and feature surface. The below are example calculations (rounded for clarity).

1) Chat Completions (classic chat endpoint)
- Pricing: model-specific per-1K input tokens and per-1K output tokens (two-sided metering).
- Example: 1000 prompt tokens + 500 completion tokens on model-redwood-large @ $0.008 per 1K prompt / $0.016 per 1K completion:
  * Prompt charge = (1000 / 1000) * $0.008 = $0.008
  * Completion charge = (500 / 1000) * $0.016 = $0.008
  * Total per-call = $0.016

2) Responses API (unified newer endpoint)
- Pricing: consolidated per-request token metering that groups prompt+completion into a single per-1K token rate (this simplifies invoices when teams migrate). Responses often yields slightly lower per-token economy because of batching optimizations we apply.
- Example: same interaction (1500 total tokens) on model-redwood-large @ $0.018 per 1K tokens (responses rate):
  * Total charge = (1500 / 1000) * $0.018 = $0.027
  * Note: Responses simplifies reconciliation — one line item for total tokens rather than two.

3) Legacy endpoints (older, deprecated endpoints customers may still call)
- Pricing: legacy endpoints historically used different metering windows and occasionally an additional per-request flag fee for streaming calls. We quote legacy usage on a case-by-case basis; for billing guidance we recommend migrating to Responses for a simpler mapping.

Worked example for monthly volume (for your traffic profile)
- Scenario: 10M prompt tokens + 4M completion tokens using Chat (classic) in a month on model-redwood-large:
  * Prompt cost = (10,000,000 / 1,000) * $0.008 = $80.00
  * Completion cost = (4,000,000 / 1,000) * $0.016 = $64.00
  * Monthly total = $144.00
- Same total tokens moved to Responses (14M total tokens) at $0.018 / 1K:
  * Monthly total = (14,000,000 / 1,000) * $0.018 = $252.00
  * Note: this simplified example highlights how per-token rates and per-side metering affect totals — real-world delta depends on your prompt/completion split and chosen models.

Discounts & committed bands (baseline)
- Standard hosted list: public rate card attached.
- Committed discounts: 5% at $25k / mo committed, 10% at $75k / mo, 15% at $200k / mo (applies to hosted usage across endpoints; exceptions: marketplace reseller SKUs).
- We can provide a custom blinded SKU if you need a single-line invoice across product surfaces.

Attachments: Redwood_RateCard_Q3_v2.pdf (simplified rate card), Draft_Commercial_Proposal_Nebula.docx (internal draft).

If this level of worked example looks good, I will convert into a one-page attachment your finance/procurement team can keep with the SOW and prep a formal commercial quote with the proposed banding and a recommended 12-month commit which unlocks the 10% band.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Lead Commercial – Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
